candidates.name: COMMISSIONER != MAKER != EXECUTOR
candidates.definition: Separate who authorizes/commissions an artifact or action from who physically makes it and who performs downstream execution.
candidates.application_guard: Never assign maker identity from authority/ownership alone.

candidates.name: PUBLIC ROLE HOLDER != ACTUAL CONTROLLER
candidates.definition: Represented office-holder and causal controller may differ; preserve both actor views and evidence.
candidates.application_guard: Hidden controller is a hypothesis until causal evidence supports it.

candidates.name: SAME OBSERVATION + DIFFERENT ACTIVE PROFILE = COMPETING INTERPRETATIONS
candidates.definition: The same artifact/event can produce different meanings under different active profile bundles; these remain competing interpretations until evidence discriminates them.
candidates.application_guard: Profile-conditioned meaning is not source fact.

candidates.name: PROFILE SPLIT TRIGGER
candidates.definition: Create a new profile candidate when a stable residual pattern cannot be represented by existing profile states without contradiction or destructive averaging.
candidates.application_guard: Do not split on cosmetic renaming or one weak anomaly.

candidates.name: NEW PARAMETER RESIDUAL TRIGGER
candidates.definition: Create a new parameter candidate when repeated unexplained residuals survive existing-parameter activation, have distinct measurement/boundary/falsifier, and recur across cases or profiles.
candidates.application_guard: Candidate only; no automatic bank insertion.

candidates.name: CONVERGENCE vs DIFFUSION vs COMMON-ORIGIN DISCRIMINATION
candidates.definition: When similar forms recur, test independent convergence, transmission/diffusion, and shared origin as separate causal hypotheses.
candidates.application_guard: Visual similarity alone cannot select genealogy.

candidates.name: VISUAL SIMILARITY != CHRONOLOGY/MATERIAL EVIDENCE
candidates.definition: Maintain separate evidence channels for appearance similarity and chronology/material/construction provenance.
candidates.application_guard: High looks-like density cannot overwrite low chronological/material fit.

candidates.name: PRESTIGE-DIFFUSION ROUTE
candidates.definition: Test whether high-status imitation can explain cross-context form similarity before invoking shared origin.
candidates.application_guard: Prestige route needs historical transmission/availability evidence.

candidates.name: HIDDEN-CONTROL CAUSAL TEST
candidates.definition: Infer hidden controller only from outcome/control dependencies, not from absence of visible authorship.

candidates.name: COLLECTIVE-CAPACITY MODEL BEFORE EXTRAORDINARY-AGENT INFERENCE
candidates.definition: Estimate labor, duration, coordination, institutional capacity and known technique before concluding an observed scale requires extraordinary agents.
candidates.application_guard: Collective explanation is also a hypothesis and must fit evidence.

candidates.name: PARAMETER NOVELTY CONFIDENCE != PROFILE FIT CONFIDENCE
candidates.definition: A profile can fit evidence strongly while its proposed new parameter remains poorly distinguished from existing parameters; track both confidences independently.
candidates.application_guard: H5 profile match cannot auto-promote a new parameter.

candidates.name: SYMBOL MEANING IS PROFILE- AND CONTEXT-CONDITIONAL
candidates.definition: A symbol's hypothesized functional meaning may change with profile, artifact context, era and source; store relation to context rather than one fixed universal meaning.
source_signals: Half/full bird, waves and cartouche meanings vary across 18 profiles

promotion_rule: Cross-case support + contradiction attack + R-F-R + explicit user review before adoption into a canonical reasoning registry.
